en.html:
It turned inside out.

Round and round, the tsurugi folded inward.
The body inside went with it.

Round and round.
Down and in.

Like folded paper, it rolled into a silver ball. Beautiful. Perfectly beautiful.

Then it turned inside out again.

Unrolling outward.
Arms and legs extending.

A neck came out.
A back straightened.

A human shape again.

Only, a size smaller now.
And the appearance was entirely different.

Glossy black hair.
A young, sweet face.
Silver armor.

A girl of silver.

それは、裏返った。

　<ruby>くるくる<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>と、劔冑は自らを内側へ巻き込む。
　中の肉体も諸共に。


　……くるくる。
　……ずぶずぶ。

　紙細工のように丸められ、
　綺麗な綺麗な白銀の球体になる。

　そしてまた裏返る。

　くるくると、外側へ広がる。
　<ruby>手足<rt>・・</rt></ruby>を伸ばす。

　<ruby>首<rt>・</rt></ruby>を出し。
　<ruby>背<rt>・</rt></ruby>を立てる。

　やがて現れるは、元通りの人の形。


　しかし身体は一回り小さくなっている。
　容姿も全く異なっている。

　<ruby>艶<rt>つや</rt></ruby>やかな黒髪。
　幼く愛らしい<ruby>貌<rt>かんばせ</rt></ruby>。
　銀色の甲鉄――

　白銀の少女。

The silver girl sang with her.

Their duet rang out.
Inside the cage, the frenzy only grew.

The Haya boy was covered in red.
His brothers and sisters, all red.

This had to stop.
I had to stop it.

Cut. That was all I had to do.
Cut down this monster.
